core-type-fontfamily-brand.$description: The only typeface in Horizon Stays. Material 3 ships on Roboto; this system keeps Inter, which every one of the 227 screens already uses.

core-type-fontweight-display-semibold-md.$description: Semibold emphasis for display md. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-display-semibold-sm.$description: Semibold emphasis for display sm. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-headline-semibold-l.$description: Semibold emphasis for headline lg. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-headline-semibold-m.$description: Semibold emphasis for headline md. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-headline-semibold-s.$description: Semibold emphasis for headline sm. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-title-semibold-lg.$description: Semibold emphasis for title lg. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-title-semibold-md.$description: Semibold emphasis for title md. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-title-semibold-sm.$description: Semibold emphasis for title sm. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-body-semibold-lg.$description: Semibold emphasis for body lg. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontweight-body-semibold-sm.$description: Semibold emphasis for body sm. Aliases fontWeight/semibold (600).

core-type-fontfamily-myanmar.$description: Burmese / Myanmar script. Padauk (SIL, Unicode) is the only Myanmar family in this file with two weights, which is what makes an emphasis rule possible.

core-type-lineheight-display-lg-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 84 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 64.

core-type-lineheight-display-md-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 66 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 52.

core-type-lineheight-display-sm-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 53 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 44.

core-type-lineheight-headline-lg-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 47 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 40.

core-type-lineheight-headline-md-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 41 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 36.

core-type-lineheight-headline-sm-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 35 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 32.

core-type-lineheight-title-lg-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 32 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 28.

core-type-lineheight-title-md-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 24 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 24.

core-type-lineheight-title-sm-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 21 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 20.

core-type-lineheight-body-lg-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 24 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 24.

core-type-lineheight-body-md-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 21 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 20.

core-type-lineheight-body-sm-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 18 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 16.

core-type-lineheight-label-lg-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 21 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 20.

core-type-lineheight-label-md-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 18 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 16.

core-type-lineheight-label-sm-myanmar.$description: Burmese line height. Padauk needs at least 16 px at this size (measured); Latin uses 16.

core-type-fontweight-myanmar-base.$description: Padauk Regular. Myanmar has two weights only, so the Latin 400/500/600 ladder does not apply.

core-type-fontweight-myanmar-bold.$description: Padauk Bold. The only emphasis weight Padauk ships — there is no Myanmar semibold.

core-type-paragraphspacing-0.$description: Space between paragraphs inside one text block.

core-type-paragraphspacing-8.$description: Space between paragraphs inside one text block.

core-type-paragraphspacing-12.$description: Space between paragraphs inside one text block.

core-type-paragraphspacing-16.$description: Space between paragraphs inside one text block.

core-type-paragraphindent-0.$description: First-line indent. Zero everywhere — UI prose is separated by space, never by indent.

core-type-size-legacy-10.$description: LEGACY. 10 px is below this system’s readable floor of 11. It exists only so body5 can describe text that already ships in the back office.

core-type-lineheight-legacy-10.$description: LEGACY. 1.4x on 10 px — the minimum that keeps Inter from colliding.

core-type-lineheight-legacy-10-myanmar.$description: LEGACY. Padauk needs 15 px at 10 px size (measured); 16 is the safe step.

core-type-fontweight-regular.$description: Inter Regular / Padauk Regular. Base weight for display, headline and body.

core-type-fontweight-medium.$description: Inter Medium. Base weight for titles and labels.

core-type-fontweight-semibold.$description: Inter Semi Bold. The first emphasis step. Latin only — Padauk has no semibold.

core-type-fontweight-bold.$description: Inter Bold / Padauk Bold. The second emphasis step, and the only emphasis Burmese has.

core-type-fontweight-display-bold-lg.$description: Bold emphasis for display lg. Aliases fontWeight/bold (700).

core-type-fontweight-display-bold-md.$description: Bold emphasis for display md. Aliases fontWeight/bold (700).

core-type-fontweight-body-bold-lg.$description: Bold emphasis for body lg. Aliases fontWeight/bold (700).
